description: Battle engineer - fights from inside a powered Mechsuit with a construct at its side, and feeds both on scrap.
_source_note: Rebuilt 5 Nov 2026 from data/reference/coa/tinker.json tab 75 (Ascension CoA Builder payload, 42 real Mechanics talents) with identity from reference/coa_sidekick (Mechanics = 'Closest to Retail Demonology Warlock'). Replaces a 24-node tree that carried real CoA names on 22 pure-scalar effects. 24 nodes kept of CoA's 42: four of CoA's are unresolved template vars in their own data ($ac/$ae/$aa/$a8), several are movement/range/channel talents this turn-based engine cannot express, and CoA splits single decisions across multiple nodes. Every surviving node either changes what you do or states a number CoA states.

nodes.name: Slam the Cogs!
nodes.description: Increases the damage you and your constructs deal by up to 8%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage dealt by you and your summons by 4%.' 2 ranks, kept as stated - one of the few CoA Mechanics talents that genuinely is a flat number.

nodes.name: Fine Tuned
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 4% and your constructs' damage by 4%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical strike and hit chance of you and your summons by 4%.' Pets have no crit key in this engine (pet_damage/pet_health/pet_armor only), so the pet half is expressed as damage; hit is dropped rather than faked.

nodes.name: Cogmaster
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%. Your critical strikes have a 50% chance to scavenge 3 Scrap and restore mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases your critical strike chance by 2% and gives ranged critical strikes a 50% chance to generate 3 Scrap.' Pays MANA, not Scrap: nothing spends Scrap yet (see the docstring), and grant_resource only takes one resource. Mana is the live, useful half; the Scrap flavour returns when a sink exists.

nodes.name: Junker
nodes.description: Spanner Smash and Scrap Shot raise your construct's damage by 5% for 5 turns, stacking twice.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Spanner Smash and Scrap Shot now increases your pet's attack power by 5% for 15 sec, stacking 2 times.' 15 sec -> 5 turns. Replaces a pure-scalar node of the same name.

nodes.name: Master Builder
nodes.description: Your Build abilities cost 30% less mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cast time of Build abilities by -50%.' There are no cast times in a turn-based engine, so the saving is repriced as mana - the resource a Build actually competes for here. POSITIVE is a reduction for _cost_pct in this engine; writing -0.30 (the intuitive sign) made Builds 30% MORE expensive, which audit_talents caught. Targets only Build abilities that exist: there is no tinker_build_scrapmaw despite the CoA talent naming one.

nodes.name: Mechanical Synergy
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Sticky Bomb and your Mechsuit abilities by 15% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the damage of Sticky Bomb Explosion and Mechsuit abilities by 15%.'

nodes.name: Sprocket Loaded
nodes.description: Casting Makeshift Dynamite resets the cooldown of your Mechsuit abilities.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Makeshift Dynamite now resets the cooldown of your Mechsuit abilities.' Ported exactly - reset_cooldown is a real proc payload in this engine (20 existing nodes use it).

nodes.name: Combat Crafter
nodes.description: While in your Mechsuit, damage dealt by your constructs has a 20% chance to scavenge 5 Scrap and restore mana.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While in your Mechsuit, damage dealt by your summons now has a 20% chance to grant you 5 Scrap and 2% of your maximum mana.' The mana half is ported because it is live; the Scrap half waits on a sink. require_mechsuit is an existing proc condition here.

nodes.name: Arclight Adept
nodes.description: Increases the critical damage of your Mechsuit abilities by 15%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the critical damage of your Mechsuit abilities by 15%.' The shipped version read '+4% Spanner Smash damage per rank', which is neither the right ability nor the right mechanic.

nodes.name: Defensive Utility
nodes.description: Your Mechsuit increases your armor by an additional 50%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Mechsuit will now increase your armor by an additional 50%.' Ideally gated on the Mechsuit being up; armor_pct has no conditional form, so it is granted flat and the 50% is left as CoA states it rather than being quietly halved to compensate.

nodes.name: Turbo Guns
nodes.description: Increases the damage of Mechsuit: Combustion by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Reduces the cast time of your Mechsuit: Combustion by 0.25 sec and its damage is increased by 20%.' Cast time is meaningless here, so only the damage half ports. SPLIT from 1 rank of 20% into 2 ranks of 10% - the same ceiling, not a buff. The rebuilt tree held 29 points with only 28 below tier 6, against a gate of 30, so its capstone was unreachable at any level. See tools/qa_talent_tiers_reachable.py.

nodes.name: Flak Guns
nodes.description: Mechsuit: Combustion deals 10% more damage and 15% more critical damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Mechsuit: Combustion now has 10% increased critical strike chance and 15% increased critical damage.' There is no per-ability crit CHANCE key in this engine - only per-ability crit damage - so the chance half is repriced as flat damage rather than written as a key nothing reads.

nodes.name: Engine Augmentation
nodes.description: For 3 turns after entering your Mechsuit, all damage you deal scavenges 3 Scrap.
nodes._source: CoA: 'For 8 seconds after activating your Mechsuit, all damage dealt will now generate 3 Scrap.' 8 sec -> 3 turns. The engine has no 'first N turns of a buff' window, so this runs for as long as the Mechsuit is up - a real simplification, noted rather than papered over.

nodes.name: Augmentor
nodes.description: While an Augmentation is active, your haste is increased by 10%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While Piercing Augmentation or Aether Augmentation is active, your ranged haste is increased by 10%.' Haste here makes you act more often on the turn meter rather than cast faster, which is the correct translation of the intent.

nodes.name: Bombs? BOMBS!
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of Sticky Bomb by 17.5% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Increases the detonation speed of Sticky Bomb by -1 sec and reduces its cooldown by -2 sec.' Detonation delay does not exist here; the cooldown cut is expressed as a percentage because this engine counts cooldowns in turns, not seconds. Positive is a reduction here, same trap as Master Builder.

nodes.name: Flame Jets
nodes.description: While in your Mechsuit, Scrap Shot and Makeshift Dynamite set the target alight, burning them for 3 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'While inside your Mechsuit, damage dealt by your Scrap Shot and Makeshift Dynamite now applies Living Flame... Deals 32 Fire Damage every 2 sec... stacking 5 times.' The Combustion-damage-taken rider is dropped: there is no per-source damage-taken modifier here.

nodes.name: Arclight Core
nodes.description: Makeshift Dynamite leaves the target burning with arclight fire for 2 turns.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Makeshift Dynamite now marks enemies for 6 sec. The next damaging ability used on this target by your pet consumes the mark to deal Fire damage.' 6 sec -> 2 turns. The pet-consumes-the-mark half is NOT ported: it would need a new proc payload, and an invented key reads as working while doing nothing. Shipped as the burn it becomes; the consume is in the handoff list.

nodes.name: Overload
nodes.description: Your Mechsuit abilities have a 40% chance to strike twice more for 30% damage.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Damage dealt by Mechsuit: Combustion and Mechsuit: Laser Beam now have a 40% chance to strike 2 additional times for 30% of the damage dealt.' extra_attack and bonus_pct are both existing proc payloads.

nodes.name: Augmechtation
nodes.description: Your Mechsuit increases your damage by an additional 10% while active.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Your Mechsuit now increases your damage by an additional 10% while active.' Same conditional gap as Defensive Utility - granted flat, stated honestly.

nodes.name: Nano-Repair Tech
nodes.description: Your attacks patch you up, healing you for a little each time you strike.
nodes._source: CoA: 'You and your pet now regenerate 3% of your maximum health every 8 sec.' There is NO health-regen effect key in this engine - health_regen_pct is read by nothing - so the self-heal is a live heal_flat proc on a 1-turn internal cooldown instead, and only the pet half stays a stat.

nodes.name: Junkyard Loiter
nodes.description: Your Mechsuit abilities plant a sticky bomb on the target, at most once every turn.
nodes._source: CoA: 'When you deal damage with Mechsuit: Laser Beam or Mechsuit: Combustion you now launch a Lesser Sticky Bomb on each target struck.' No separate Lesser bomb exists here, so it casts the real Sticky Bomb on a 1-turn internal cooldown to stop it chaining.

nodes.name: Haywired State!
nodes.description: Casting a Mechsuit ability sends your construct haywire for 2 turns, making its attacks chain to nearby enemies.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Casting Mechsuit abilities now causes your pet to enter a haywired state for 6 seconds... auto attacks now zap up to 10 nearby enemies.' 6 sec -> 2 turns. Pet AoE is not modelled, so the chain is expressed as a pet damage buff rather than invented.

nodes.name: Turbo Upgrade!
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Mechsuit abilities by 100% and the duration of your Mechsuit by 100%.
nodes._source: CoA: 'Level 40 Passive. Increases the effectiveness of your Mechsuit by 100%.' CoA does not say what 'effectiveness' covers; read here as the two Mechsuit abilities' damage and the form's own duration, which is the reading that makes it a capstone rather than a stat stick.

nodes.name: Makeshift Dynamite
nodes.description: Learn Makeshift Dynamite. A stick of something you threw together, and it burns.
nodes._source: Same tier as before the rebuild.

nodes.name: Build: Mechsuit
nodes.description: Learn Build: Mechsuit. Climb into the suit. Your abilities change while you are in it.
nodes._source: The gateway for the whole mechsuit kit: the two abilities below require the form, and several nodes in this tree carry require_mechsuit. Same tier as before the rebuild.

nodes.name: Mechsuit: Laser Beam
nodes.description: Learn Mechsuit: Laser Beam. A sustained fire beam, available only from inside the suit.
nodes._source: Requires the Mechsuit form, so it hangs off Build: Mechsuit rather than sitting loose in the tree.

nodes.name: Mechsuit: Combustion
nodes.description: Learn Mechsuit: Combustion. Vents the whole reactor into everything around you.
nodes._source: The suit's area attack and the deepest of the three, so it is the last of the kit you can reach. Was tier 4.
